release_notes: Build 140 fixes whole-app stalls that could become noticeable after social credentials are configured by removing recursive legacy project-path recovery from the routine Full Autopilot loop.
Full Autopilot now loads quiz history and YouTube growth snapshots away from the WPF UI thread before running its social and post-release checks.

Instagram and Needs You background sync is throttled from every second to every five seconds, guarded against overlap, and performs history, publication and project-file checks away from the UI thread.
The five-minute Instagram promo candidate scan also runs off the dispatcher; Facebook, YouTube and Instagram credentials and publishing behaviour are unchanged.
